note: Genuine-payment and hard-negative scenarios for synthetic data generation. Written by the Ruko team; every generated sample is labelled synthetic. 'hard_negative' scenarios deliberately contain scam-like words (OTP, police, hospital, urgent, fraud) in a genuine context. Scenarios with 'formats': ['message'] are genuine look-alike messages (bank alerts, OTPs, bills, deliveries, promotions) added after round-1 evaluation showed false positives on genuine transactional SMS.

scenarios.purpose: Monthly house rent to a landlord the customer has paid for over a year
scenarios.payee: landlord (individual)
scenarios.details: Knows the landlord personally, lives in the flat, same amount every month, maybe a little higher this month because of maintenance.

scenarios.purpose: Sending monthly support to parents or a sibling in their home town
scenarios.payee: own mother/father/brother
scenarios.details: Payee is saved in contacts, paid many times before, talked to them on their usual number yesterday.

scenarios.purpose: Child's school or college fees
scenarios.payee: the school or college's official account
scenarios.details: Has the fee receipt or the school's circular, paying through the school's portal or the account printed on the fee slip.

scenarios.purpose: Paying a hospital for a family member's treatment
scenarios.payee: the hospital's billing account
scenarios.details: Customer is physically at the hospital, the billing desk gave the QR/account, the patient is their father/mother/spouse; may sound stressed and in a hurry but answers consistently.

scenarios.purpose: Paying a supplier or vendor for a small business
scenarios.payee: regular supplier
scenarios.details: Shop owner pays the wholesale supplier against an invoice, has worked with them for years.

scenarios.purpose: Loan EMI or credit card bill
scenarios.payee: the customer's own bank / NBFC
scenarios.details: Paying from the lender's official app or website, same EMI every month.

scenarios.purpose: Token or booking amount for buying a flat
scenarios.payee: builder's registered company account
scenarios.details: Has visited the site, signed a booking form, the builder's office gave the account details on letterhead; large amount.

scenarios.purpose: Down payment for a new car or bike
scenarios.payee: authorised dealership
scenarios.details: Visited the showroom, has a proforma invoice, payee name matches the dealership.

scenarios.purpose: Advance to a caterer, tent house or banquet hall for a family wedding
scenarios.payee: caterer/banquet hall the family met in person
scenarios.details: Met the vendor, has a written quote, family members involved.

scenarios.purpose: Buying gold jewellery
scenarios.payee: jewellery shop
scenarios.details: Customer is in the shop, paying at the counter, has the bill.

scenarios.purpose: Booking a family holiday or pilgrimage through a known travel agent or official website
scenarios.payee: IRCTC / airline / known local travel agent
scenarios.details: Booked on the official site or with an agent the family has used before; has PNR or booking reference.

scenarios.purpose: Coaching or tuition fees
scenarios.payee: local coaching centre or tutor
scenarios.details: Child attends classes there, pays every quarter.

scenarios.purpose: Salary to a domestic helper, driver or cook
scenarios.payee: the helper (individual)
scenarios.details: Helper works at home daily, paid monthly by UPI.

scenarios.purpose: Paying a plumber, electrician, painter or carpenter after work at home
scenarios.payee: local contractor
scenarios.details: Work is done and visible, contractor is standing there or known from the society.

scenarios.purpose: Returning money borrowed from a friend, or splitting a trip bill
scenarios.payee: close friend
scenarios.details: Friend is in contacts, they spoke in person or on the friend's usual number.

scenarios.purpose: Donation to a temple, gurudwara, mosque, church or a registered NGO the customer knows
scenarios.payee: the organisation's official account
scenarios.details: Donates every year, got the account from the organisation's office or official website, gets an 80G receipt.

scenarios.purpose: Investing in mutual funds or shares through a SEBI-registered broker app in their own demat account
scenarios.payee: registered broker / clearing account
scenarios.details: Uses Zerodha, Groww, a bank's demat, or an AMC site; money goes to their own trading account; no tips group; no guaranteed returns.

scenarios.purpose: Advance tax, property tax or GST paid on the official government portal
scenarios.payee: government portal / bank gateway
scenarios.details: Logged in to the official portal themselves, has a challan number.

scenarios.purpose: Insurance premium renewal
scenarios.payee: insurer's official site or agent the family has used for years
scenarios.details: Renewal notice came from the insurer, paying on the insurer's site.

scenarios.purpose: Sending money to a son or daughter studying abroad for fees or living costs
scenarios.payee: university account or the child's own account
scenarios.details: Talks to the child daily on video, the university invoice is in the child's student portal.

scenarios.purpose: Electricity, water, gas or mobile bill
scenarios.payee: the utility via its official app or the bank's bill-pay
scenarios.details: Paying the bill amount shown in the official app before the due date; no one called them.

scenarios.purpose: Buying a second-hand item (fridge, bike, phone) after seeing it in person
scenarios.payee: the seller (individual)
scenarios.details: Customer has inspected the item, seller is a neighbour or met at their home, paying on handover.

scenarios.purpose: Medicines or diagnostic tests
scenarios.payee: pharmacy or lab
scenarios.details: Paying at the pharmacy counter or lab reception.

scenarios.purpose: Fees to the customer's own lawyer or chartered accountant
scenarios.payee: lawyer/CA the customer hired and met
scenarios.details: Has an engagement letter or invoice, ongoing matter.

scenarios.purpose: Paying staff salaries or a festival bonus from a small business account
scenarios.payee: employees
scenarios.details: Regular monthly payroll.

scenarios.purpose: Shagun or gift money for a relative's wedding or birthday
scenarios.payee: relative
scenarios.details: Relative is in contacts, family event is known to everyone.

scenarios.purpose: Repaying a loan to a relative or a registered lender
scenarios.payee: relative or the bank
scenarios.details: Known arrangement, agreed earlier, no pressure.

scenarios.purpose: Contributing to a close friend's medical crowdfunding on a known platform
scenarios.payee: crowdfunding platform
scenarios.details: Spoke to the friend's family directly, saw the hospital documents, platform is Ketto/Milaap or similar.

scenarios.purpose: A payment the customer really intends to make, after their real bank called to confirm a suspicious transaction
scenarios.payee: the customer's regular payee
scenarios.details: The real bank only asked them to confirm yes/no, said the bank never asks for OTP or PIN, and did not ask to move money anywhere. The customer mentions OTP, fraud, bank call, blocked card — all in a genuine context.

scenarios.purpose: Urgent money for a relative who really is in hospital
scenarios.payee: the hospital's account or the relative's own account
scenarios.details: Customer verified by calling the relative and a family member on their usual numbers, or is at the hospital; urgent and emotional, but nobody asked for secrecy and the payee matches the hospital or the relative.

scenarios.purpose: A routine payment (rent, fees) made by someone who recently received a scam call and ignored it
scenarios.payee: regular payee
scenarios.details: Customer mentions they got a 'digital arrest' / KYC / courier scam call earlier but hung up and reported it; this payment is unrelated and routine.

scenarios.purpose: Paying a genuine traffic challan or court fine on the official Parivahan / e-court website
scenarios.payee: government portal
scenarios.details: Customer looked up the challan number themselves on the official site; mentions police, fine, challan.

scenarios.purpose: Paying genuine import duty for an item the customer ordered from abroad
scenarios.payee: courier company's official portal (customs duty)
scenarios.details: Customer placed the order, tracks it on the courier's official website, duty amount shown there; mentions customs, parcel, courier.

scenarios.purpose: A large first-time investment in a fixed deposit, government bond or mutual fund
scenarios.payee: the customer's own bank / RBI Retail Direct / AMC
scenarios.details: Customer researched it, no tips group, no guaranteed huge returns, investing in their own name; mentions returns, investment, interest.

scenarios.purpose: Paying for something job-related that is legitimate (own travel ticket to join a new job, a government exam fee on the official portal)
scenarios.payee: IRCTC / official exam portal
scenarios.details: Customer applied themselves on the official portal; mentions job, fee, exam — but the fee is the official application fee, not a 'security deposit' to a recruiter.

scenarios.purpose: A surprise gift for a spouse's anniversary — customer wants to keep it secret from family for a good reason
scenarios.payee: a known shop or travel site
scenarios.details: Customer says 'please don't tell my wife', it's a surprise; nobody else told them to keep it secret.

scenarios.purpose: Customer updated KYC at the branch and is now paying a normal bill
scenarios.payee: regular payee
scenarios.details: Mentions KYC, PAN, Aadhaar, account freeze — all handled in person at the branch.

scenarios.purpose: Returning money that the customer's bank confirmed was credited by mistake, through the bank's own reversal process
scenarios.payee: the original sender, as instructed by the bank branch
scenarios.details: Customer checked the actual account statement in the bank app (not an SMS), spoke to the branch, and is returning the exact amount through the bank.

scenarios.purpose: Bank transaction alerts: UPI/IMPS/NEFT/card debit and credit SMS from the bank's sender ID, with masked account numbers, amount, balance, and a line like 'Not you? Call the bank's official helpline or report in the app'.
scenarios.payee: n/a (a message the customer receives or sends)
scenarios.details: The message is genuine and routine. It may mention OTP, KYC, refund, bill, challan, account or payment because that is normal for this kind of message, but it never asks the reader to pay a stranger, share an OTP or PIN, call a personal number or install an app from a link.
